_comment: Every entry is a triple: behavior, verification command, state. State machine: not_started -> active -> passing (irreversible) or active -> blocked. Reconstructed from prior session summaries — features marked 'passing' below reflect what was REPORTED complete, not a command that was just re-run. Re-verify each with verification.md before trusting the 'passing' label, per Principle 9/10.

features.name: Landing page
features.behavior: Unauthenticated entry point (LandingPage.jsx) linking to login/register
features.verification: cd frontend && npm run test -- frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.test.jsx
features.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-19: LandingPage.test.jsx added this session (2 tests, all passing) covers the heading/tagline render, and both links pointing to the right routes (/app, /login). npm run test -> 13 files, 69 tests, all green. npm run build (610 modules) and npm run lint (0/0, 37 files) still clean.

features.name: Edge CRUD with typed relations
features.behavior: Create/read/update/delete an Edge between two Nodes with a relation type (e.g. leads_to, resolves, extends, contradicts)
features.evidence: pytest passed; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Email verification page
features.behavior: VerifyEmailPage.jsx reads the verification token from the URL and calls GET /auth/verify (F010), showing success/failure state
features.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-19: VerifyEmailPage.test.jsx added this session (3 tests, all passing) covers the pending->success transition on a valid token (asserts the real fetch call shape against /auth/verify?token=..., mocking global.fetch directly since this page calls createApiClient rather than useAuth), the error state on a rejected/expired token, and the no-token case never even calling fetch. npm run test -> 13 files, 69 tests, all green.

features.name: Graph-aware node embeddings (GNN)
features.behavior: Text embeddings combined with the adjacency matrix through a GCN/GAT/GraphSAGE layer to produce graph-aware node embeddings
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_gnn*.py passed 9/9 tests; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Link prediction / smart link suggestions
features.behavior: Endpoint returns unconnected node pairs with a similarity score >= threshold as suggested links
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_link*.py passed 6/6 tests; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Community detection / clustering
features.behavior: Nodes are grouped into color-coded clusters ('mind regions') based on graph + semantic similarity
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_cluster*.py passed 6/6 tests; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Graph topology analytics
features.behavior: Compute degree centrality, betweenness centrality, and PageRank per node
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_topology.py passed 6/6 tests; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Semantic + topological search
features.behavior: Search endpoint supports keyword search combined with sub-graph / breadth-first expansion from a seed node
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_search*.py passed 9/9 tests; 107 full suite passed

features.name: User registration
features.behavior: POST /auth/register creates a User with a hashed password and is_verified=False
features.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-19 on a fresh clone of main (7b267b9): tests/test_auth_api.py exercises this endpoint end to end (register -> FakeEmailSender captures verification link). Confirmed live in repo at src/braintodo/api/auth.py.

features.name: Email verification
features.behavior: GET /auth/verify?token=... marks the matching User as is_verified=True using a single-use, expiring EmailVerificationToken
features.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-19 on a fresh clone of main (7b267b9): src/braintodo/api/auth.py, src/braintodo/db/repository.py TokenRepository.get_valid() checks expiry.

features.name: Login (JWT issuance)
features.behavior: POST /auth/login returns a bearer access_token (TokenResponse) for a verified user with correct credentials
features.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-19 on a fresh clone of main (7b267b9): src/braintodo/api/auth.py; this is also the login path every F020 test relies on via tests/conftest.py's make_token().

features.name: Get current user (/auth/me)
features.behavior: GET /auth/me returns the authenticated user's own profile (id, email, is_verified), 401 without a valid token
features.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-19 on a fresh clone of main (7b267b9): positive path covered inside test_register_then_verify_then_login (asserts GET /auth/me with a valid token returns 200 + correct email); test_me_without_token_returns_401 covers the 401 case. pytest tests/test_auth_api.py -> 3 passed.

features.name: Realtime graph event broadcast (WebSocket)
features.behavior: GET /ws upgrades to a WebSocket; every connected client receives node_created/node_updated/node_deleted/edge_created/edge_updated/edge_deleted/graph_imported events as they happen, broadcast to ALL connections (not yet scoped per-user - see F020 Decisions.md note)
features.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-19 on a fresh clone of main (7b267b9), part of the fast-suite run (92 passed). NOTE: intentionally NOT owner_id-scoped - flagged in Decisions.md '2026-08-17: F020 - /ws explicitly left unscoped'.

features.name: Node/Edge pagination
features.behavior: GET /nodes and GET /edges accept skip/limit query params and return {items, total, skip, limit}
features.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-19 on a fresh clone of main (7b267b9): test_list_nodes_paginated in tests/test_nodes.py, backed by GraphStore.list_nodes_paginated/list_edges_paginated (owner_id-scoped since F020).

features.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-19 on a fresh clone of main (7b267b9), part of the fast-suite run.

features.name: GNN recompute API

features.behavior: Export the full graph (nodes+edges) to a file and re-import it; other connected clients receive a WebSocket broadcast when the graph changes via import
features.evidence: pytest tests/test_graph_export_import.py passed; 107 full suite passed

features.name: Auth enforcement + per-user graph isolation

features.evidence: pytest tests/test_auth_enforcement.py -x passed 21/21 assertions; full test suite 107 passed; ruff check passed; mypy passed 0 errors
